props.description: `filter`: only the hits and their ancestors stay; `highlight`: all nodes stay, the hits are marked

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the tree, also its accessible name

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name without a visible label

props.name: filter
props.description: Search field above the tree; hits stay with their ancestors (opened), hits are marked

props.name: expandControls
props.description: Buttons "Expand all" and "Collapse all" above the tree

props.name: showLines
props.description: Guide lines along the children of open branches

props.name: renderNode
props.description: Content of a node (instead of icon and label); chevron and check box stay

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown without nodes (default "No entries") or without hits ("No matches")

props.name: empty
props.description: Replaces the text shown without nodes or hits

props.name: ref
props.description: Methods: expandAll, collapseAll, invalidate, focusNode

components.name: Treemap
components.description: A list of the items with value and share; the tiles show the shares as areas

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list (and visible title with `showTitle`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the area in pt (default 240) – the tiles fill the width

props.name: locale
props.description: Default: the LocaleProvider's

components.name: TreeSelect
components.description: Select whose options are a tree: the trigger opens a sheet with the tree. One node is a radio button – choosing it closes the sheet; with `multiple` the nodes are check boxes with cascade and the field shows chips.

props.name: value
props.description: Chosen node id (an array of ids with `multiple`)

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the sheet – default: the Field label or the placeholder

props.name: leavesOnly
props.description: Only nodes without children can be chosen; pressing a branch opens it

props.name: defaultExpandedValue
props.description: Open nodes when the sheet opens – default: the path of the chosen node(s)

props.name: multiple
props.description: Several nodes, chosen with check boxes; shown as chips in the field

props.name: checkedStrategy
props.description: Which checked ids make up the value (`multiple`): `parent` (default) – a fully checked branch instead of its children, `all`, or `child` – only leaves

props.name: checkStrictly
props.description: Check boxes of parents and children are independent (`multiple`)

props.name: maxShown
props.description: Chips shown before "+N" (`multiple`)

props.name: filter
props.description: Search field above the tree

props.name: clearable
props.description: Button next to the field that clears the value

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button (default "Clear selection")

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in the field (busy)

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the field: 32, 40 (default) or 48 pt

props.name: loadChildren
props.description: Loads the children of lazy nodes (`hasChildren: true`) when they open; they are kept while the field lives

props.name: onLoadChildren
props.description: A lazy node opened and there is no loadChildren/dataSource: add its children to the items

props.name: dataSource
props.description: Source of the children of lazy nodes (`getChildren`)

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name without a surrounding Field

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the sheet's close button

components.name: Truncate
components.description: Cuts a text after a number of lines (numberOfLines) – with "Show more" or the full text as tooltip. Measures whether it is really cut; screen readers always read the full text.

props.name: lines
props.description: Lines before the text is cut (default 1)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: The full text on a long press (or hover/focus on the web), only while cut (default true)

props.name: expandable
props.description: "Show more" below the cut text instead of the tooltip

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Text of the button while cut (default "Show more")

props.name: lessLabel
props.description: Text of the button while expanded (default "Show less")

components.name: VirtualList
components.description: A long list that renders only what is in view (FlatList; with `itemGroup` a SectionList with sticky headings). The end loads more (`hasMore` + `onLoadMore`, or a data source) – "Load more" does the same for screen reader and keyboard users; loading, empty and error rows at the end, the data source's state announced.

props.name: items
props.description: The items (with `dataSource` the list loads them itself)

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Fixed height of every item in pt: the list knows all positions without measuring (getItemLayout) – faster scrolling and `scrollToIndex` to any item. Leave it out when the items differ in height.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scroll area, e.g. 320 or "100%" (default 320)

props.name: itemGroup
props.description: Group heading of an item (property name or function): a SectionList whose headings stick to the top

props.name: hasMore
props.description: More items can be loaded: the end of the list (or "Load more") calls onLoadMore

props.name: loading
props.description: The next items are loading: a loading row at the end (aria-busy)

props.name: endThreshold
props.description: How many items before the end onLoadMore is called (default 5)

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: The end of the list came near (hasMore) or "Load more" was pressed – load the next items

props.name: dataSource
props.description: Loads the items page by page while scrolling (instead of `items`); errors show "Try again"

props.name: query
props.description: Sorting, filters and search for the data source; a change starts over

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Items per request of the data source (default 50)

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when there is no item (default "No entries")

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one item

props.name: ref
props.description: Methods: scrollToIndex, refresh

components.name: Watermark
components.description: Repeats a text or image over the content, e.g. "Draft" or "Confidential" – decoration only (drawn as SVG, hidden from screen readers, presses go through).

props.name: children
props.description: The content under the watermark

components.name: Wizard
components.description: Multi-step form on the Stepper: "Next" checks the step (async with a spinner; a failed check is announced), "Back" keeps everything; an optional summary step before finishing.

props.name: step
props.description: Current step (0-based; steps + summary = done) – controlled with onStepChange

props.name: onComplete
props.description: The last step was finished (after its check)

props.name: renderStep
props.description: Content of a step – its fields stay in the form state, so going back loses nothing

props.name: summary
props.description: A last step with this summary before finishing

props.name: summaryLabel
props.description: Name of the summary step (default "Summary")

props.name: completed
props.description: Shown after finishing

props.name: orientation
props.description: `vertical`: the steps with their labels top to bottom

components.name: YearPicker
components.description: Year field ("2026"): picks from a grid of twelve years; range: start – end

props.name: range
props.description: Start and end instead of one

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable period (same format as the value)

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable period

props.name: presets
props.description: Buttons below the grid: "thisMonth", "lastQuarter", "last3Years" … or own { label, value }

props.name: clearable
props.description: Clear button in the field while it has a value

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name without a surrounding Field

props.name: value
props.description: Year as "2026"; with range { start, end }

functions.name: announce
functions.description: Reads a text to screen reader users, e.g. "3 entries deleted": iOS and Android through AccessibilityInfo (assertive interrupts the current speech on iOS), the web through a live region – the one of <LiveAnnouncer>, else one at the end of the page.

functions.name: bindCheckbox
functions.description: Props for Checkbox and Switch

functions.name: bindInput
functions.description: Props for Input, Textarea, PasswordInput, MaskInput …: `<Input {...bindInput(field)} />`

functions.name: bindValue
functions.description: Props for Select, MultiSelect, RadioGroup, ChipGroup, SegmentedControl, DatePicker, NumberInput … – a choice in a sheet has no blur, so choosing marks the field touched as well

functions.name: cameraPicker
functions.description: A new photo from the camera – asks for the permission first

functions.name: closeAllDialogs
functions.description: Closes every dialog of the DialogHost – their promises resolve with undefined

functions.name: confirm
functions.description: Asks for a confirmation in the app-wide <ConfirmDialog />: resolves with true, or false when cancelled (also the back button, Escape or a newer confirm/prompt)

functions.name: documentPicker
functions.description: Documents from the system's file picker (Files on iOS, the document picker on Android, the file dialog on the web)

functions.name: firstError
functions.description: First readable message of TanStack Form errors (strings or Standard Schema issues).

functions.name: focusControl
functions.description: Moves the focus to the control of `id`: text fields get the keyboard focus, every control the screen reader focus (iOS/Android); on the web the element with that id. False when nothing has the id.

functions.name: fonts
functions.description: The WireLayer fonts, bundled with the app (no CDN). One family per weight, named like the `font-*` classes expect. Load them before the first render: `const [loaded] = useFonts(fonts)` (expo-font).

functions.name: imageLibraryPicker
functions.description: Photos (and videos) from the photo library

functions.name: openDialog
functions.description: Opens a dialog in the app-wide <DialogHost /> from anywhere (no state in the screen): resolves with the value passed to `close(result)`, or undefined when dismissed. Dialogs opened from a dialog stack on top of it.

functions.name: prompt
functions.description: Asks for a text in the app-wide <ConfirmDialog />: resolves with the value, or null when cancelled

functions.name: setAppearance
functions.description: Switches the colour theme and light/dark mode – the counterpart of `data-theme` / `data-mode` on the web. Custom themes have to be registered as `extraThemes` (see `nativeExtraThemes()` from

functions.name: shareFile
functions.description: Writes the file to the app's cache and opens the share sheet (save to Files, mail, other apps): `<DataTable onExport={shareFile} … />`. Resolves false when the device cannot share.

functions.name: shareUri
functions.description: Opens the share sheet for a file that is already on the device or online (`file://…` or `https://…`), e.g. the `src` of a PdfViewer: `<PdfViewer onShare={shareUri} … />`. Remote files are downloaded to the cache first.

functions.name: useAppState
functions.description: State of the app: 'active' in the foreground, 'background' or 'inactive' (iOS: app switcher, call)

functions.name: useClipboard
functions.description: Copies text to the clipboard: `const { copy, copied, error, reset } = useClipboard()` – `copied` is true for `timeout` ms (default 2000), the same API as the web hook.

functions.name: useColorScheme
functions.description: The colour scheme of the device: 'light' or 'dark' (`initialValue` while the system does not say)

functions.name: useDebouncedCallback
functions.description: A function that runs `fn` once `wait` ms passed without another call – with `cancel`, `flush` and `pending`. Always calls the latest `fn`; cancelled when the component unmounts.

functions.name: useDebouncedValue
functions.description: A copy of `value` that follows only after `wait` ms without changes (search fields)

functions.name: useDisclosure
functions.description: Open/closed state of a dialog, drawer, sheet …: `const { opened, open, close, toggle } = useDisclosure()`

functions.name: useDocumentVisibility
functions.description: 'visible' while the app is in the foreground, else 'hidden' – the counterpart of the web hook (pause timers)

functions.name: useFieldControl
functions.description: Props a control inside a Field spreads onto its TextInput/Pressable

functions.name: useFormErrors
functions.description: The errors of a TanStack form for FormErrorSummary: one entry per touched field with an error, linked to the field; `attempts` (submit attempts) refocuses the summary on every submit: `<FormErrorSummary errors={summary.errors} focusKey={summary.attempts} />`

functions.name: useInterval
functions.description: Runs `fn` every `interval` ms while active (starts on mount unless `autoStart: false`)

functions.name: useLocale
functions.description: Locale and texts of the nearest LocaleProvider – English (en-US) without one

functions.name: useSelection
functions.description: Selected items of a list: toggle, select all, clear – with "all"/"some" for a header checkbox or an ActionBar

functions.name: useStateHistory
functions.description: A value with undo and redo: `set` adds a step, `undo`/`redo` move through them

functions.name: useThrottledCallback
functions.description: A function that runs `fn` at most once per `wait` ms (scrolling, gestures)

functions.name: useTimeout
functions.description: Runs `fn` once after `delay` ms when started (on mount with `autoStart`)

functions.name: useTranslations
functions.description: Texts of the nearest LocaleProvider

functions.name: useValidators
functions.description: The validators with the texts and number format of the nearest LocaleProvider: `const v = useValidators()`, then `validators: { onChange: v.combine(v.isRequired(), v.isEmail()) }`. Each validator is a Standard Schema, so TanStack Form takes it directly.

functions.name: validateFields
functions.description: Validates some fields of a TanStack form (e.g. one Wizard step) and marks them touched, so their errors show. Resolves with true when none has an error.

functions.name: bindCheckbox
functions.description: v-bind for Checkbox and Switch

functions.name: bindInput
functions.description: v-bind for the components with a string v-model: Input, Textarea, PasswordInput, SearchField, MaskInput, PhoneInput, ColorInput, JsonInput, PinInput, Mentions and Autocomplete – `<Input v-bind="bindInput(field)" />`

functions.name: bindValue
functions.description: v-bind for Select, RadioGroup, ChipGroup and SegmentedControl

functions.name: closeAllDialogs
functions.description: Closes all dialogs of the <DialogHost />; their promises resolve with undefined

functions.name: confirm
functions.description: Asks for confirmation in the app-wide <ConfirmDialog />. Resolves with true (confirmed) or false (cancelled, Escape, a newer confirm()).

functions.name: createToaster
functions.description: A toaster of its own, e.g. for a second position on the screen: `const { toaster, toast } = createToaster({ placement: 'top' })`, rendered by `<Toaster :toaster="toaster" />`.

functions.name: dateInput
functions.description: DataTable feature: the DatePicker for `date` and `datetime` filters and editors (without: the browser's date input)

functions.name: defaultBubbleTools
functions.description: Tools of the bubble menu (text selected) by default

functions.name: defaultFloatingTools
functions.description: Tools of the floating menu (empty line) by default

functions.name: defaultTools
functions.description: Tools in order; '|' draws a separator

functions.name: firstError
functions.description: First readable message of TanStack Form errors (strings or Standard Schema issues).

functions.name: navigationProgress
functions.description: Controls the app-wide <NavigationProgress />, e.g. from router hooks

functions.name: numberInput
functions.description: DataTable feature: the NumberInput for `number` filters and editors (without: the browser's number input)

functions.name: openDialog
functions.description: Opens a component in a dialog of the app-wide <DialogHost />. Resolves with what the component passes to `close(result)`, or undefined when closed with Escape or the close button. The returned promise also has `close(result)` and `update(changes)`; dialogs opened from a dialog stack on top of it.

functions.name: prompt
functions.description: Asks for a text in the app-wide <ConfirmDialog />. Resolves with the (valid) text, or null when cancelled.

functions.name: provideRecipes
functions.description: Adds overrides for the components below (inner ones win) – used by RecipesProvider

functions.name: useClipboard
functions.description: Copies text; `copied` is true for `timeout` ms afterwards (for a "Copied" state), `error` holds a failure

functions.name: useColorScheme
functions.description: The colour scheme of the system: 'light' or 'dark' ('light' on the server)

functions.name: useDebouncedCallback
functions.description: A function that runs `fn` once `wait` ms passed without another call – with `cancel`, `flush` and `pending`. Cancelled when the component unmounts.

functions.name: useDebouncedValue
functions.description: A copy of `value` that follows only after `wait` ms without changes (search fields, resizing)

functions.name: useDisclosure
functions.description: Open/closed state of a dialog, drawer, menu …: `const { opened, open, close, toggle } = useDisclosure()`

functions.name: useDocumentTitle
functions.description: Sets the document title while mounted and whenever it changes (restores the previous one with `restore`)

functions.name: useDocumentVisibility
functions.description: 'visible' or 'hidden' (another tab, minimised) – 'visible' on the server

functions.name: useElementSize
functions.description: Width and height of an element (content box, px; 0 until measured)

functions.name: useEyeDropper
functions.description: The EyeDropper API (Chromium): pick a colour anywhere on the screen; `open` resolves with the hex colour or null

functions.name: useFileDialog
functions.description: Opens the system's file dialog; `files` holds the last choice

functions.name: useFocusReturn
functions.description: Brings the focus back after a panel closes: remembers the focused element when `opened` turns true, focuses it again when it turns false. Returns the function that does it by hand.

functions.name: useFocusTrap
functions.description: Keeps Tab inside an element while `active` (bind `ref` to it) and focuses its first control

functions.name: useFormErrors
functions.description: The errors of a TanStack form for FormErrorSummary: one entry per touched field with an error, linked to the field; `attempts` (submit attempts) refocuses the summary on every submit: `<FormErrorSummary :errors="summary.errors.value" :focus-key="summary.attempts.value" />`

functions.name: useFullscreen
functions.description: Fullscreen for an element (bind `ref` to it; without one the whole page): `fullscreen` says whether it is shown in fullscreen, `toggle` switches

functions.name: useHeadroom
functions.description: Headroom: true while a header should hide (scrolling down past `offset`), false when scrolling up

functions.name: useHotkey
functions.description: One shortcut while mounted: `useHotkey('?', openHelp, { description: 'Help' })`

functions.name: useHotkeys
functions.description: Shortcuts while the component is mounted: `useHotkeys([['mod+k', openSearch, { description: 'Open search' }], ['g i', goToInbox]])`. "mod" is Strg or ⌘; space separates the steps of a sequence. Plain keys do not fire while typing in a field (see `enableInInputs`); every entry shows up in the HotkeysDialog when it has a description. `options` apply to all entries (an entry's own options win).

functions.name: useIdle
functions.description: Whether the user did nothing (mouse, keyboard, touch, scroll) for `timeout` ms

functions.name: useIntersection
functions.description: The IntersectionObserver entry of an element (bind `ref` to it)

functions.name: useInterval
functions.description: Runs `fn` every `interval` ms while active (starts on mount unless `autoStart: false`)

functions.name: useInViewport
functions.description: Whether an element is (partly) in the viewport (bind `ref` to it)

functions.name: useIsApple
functions.description: Whether the device is an Apple one (⌘ instead of Strg) – false on the server and until mounted

functions.name: useLandmarks
functions.description: F6 / Shift+F6 jump between the landmarks of the page while mounted (header, navigation, main, aside, toasts …)

functions.name: useLocale
functions.description: Locale, writing direction and texts of the nearest LocaleProvider – English (en-US) without one

functions.name: useLocalStorage
functions.description: A JSON value in localStorage under `key`, as a ref: assigning stores it (undefined removes it), changes from other tabs and other components arrive. The default on the server and until mounted.

functions.name: useLongPress
functions.description: Pressing and holding (`delay` ms, default 500) calls `onLongPress` – with mouse, touch and pen. Bind the returned handlers to the element: `v-bind="longPress"`; the click that ends a long press is swallowed.

functions.name: useMediaQuery
functions.description: Whether a media query matches, e.g. `useMediaQuery('(min-width: 768px)')` – updates when it changes

functions.name: useNetwork
functions.description: Online state and connection quality (where the browser tells) – online on the server

functions.name: useRecipe
functions.description: The recipe with the defaults and classes of the nearest RecipesProvider and the component's `classes` prop. Call it in setup; it reads both on every call, so a computed or render that calls it follows changes.

functions.name: useReducedMotion
functions.description: Whether the user asked for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)

functions.name: useRegisteredHotkeys
functions.description: The registered shortcuts (enabled, with a description), updated as components register them

functions.name: useResizeObserver
functions.description: The content box of an element as it changes (bind `ref` to it)

functions.name: useScrollSpy
functions.description: The id of the section being read: the last of `ids` whose top passed `offset` px (e.g. a sticky header) – for a table of contents

functions.name: useSelection
functions.description: Selected items of a list: toggle, select all, clear – with "all"/"some" for a header checkbox

functions.name: useSessionStorage
functions.description: Like useLocalStorage, in sessionStorage (this tab only, gone when it closes)

functions.name: useStateHistory
functions.description: A value with undo and redo: `set` adds a step, `undo`/`redo` move through them

functions.name: useThrottledCallback
functions.description: A function that runs `fn` at most once per `wait` ms (scroll, pointer move)

functions.name: useTimeout
functions.description: Runs `fn` once after `delay` ms when started (on mount with `autoStart`)

functions.name: useTranslations
functions.description: Texts of the nearest LocaleProvider; `const t = translations.dataTable` stays current, too

functions.name: useValidators
functions.description: The validators with the texts and number format of the nearest LocaleProvider: `const v = useValidators()`, then `validators: { onChange: v.combine(v.isRequired(), v.isEmail()) }`. Each validator is a Standard Schema, so TanStack Form takes it directly.

functions.name: useWindowScroll
functions.description: Scroll position of the window and `scrollTo` (0 on the server)

functions.name: validateFields
functions.description: Validates some fields of a TanStack form (e.g. one Wizard step) and marks them touched, so their errors show. Resolves with true when none has an error.

functions.name: virtualRows
functions.description: DataTable feature: only the visible rows are rendered with `virtual` – `<DataTable :features="[virtualRows]" virtual>`
